question: The Best Picture award went to which of the following films at the 98th Academy Awards?
solution:
The correct answer is __**One Battle After Another.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **"One Battle After Another" won Best Picture at the 98th Academy Awards.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The film is a political epic directed by Paul Thomas Anderson.
 
• It is about a faded revolutionary in a dystopian police state America.
 
• Producer Sara Murphy and director Anderson accepted the award.
 
• It defeated the heavily-nominated film "Sinners" in a tight race.
